name: Abat Oliba CEU
description: Abat Oliba CEU University is a private university belonging to the Group CEU University, the first private educational group in Spain by number of students and the second by quality of their studies (Higher Education Ranking - 2020). The Institution began its studies in 1977. ﻿All its study programs are official and are recognized in the European Higher Education Area. It is a University specialized in the areas of Law and Economics, Communication, Humanities and Education and Psychology, recognized for being the first in teaching quality and in employability of the Barcelona region. The University stands out for the values ​​of the CEU, represented in the accompaniment continued of the students in teaching, by the orientation to the professional career and by their international dimension, manifested in the high number of international students in their classrooms.
